name: O365 Mass Sharing Link Creation - Before Tuning
description: Initial broad rule for SharePoint sharing activity. This version is intentionally noisy and incomplete for before-tuning documentation.
known_issues: The query is too broad and does not specifically target sharing link creation
The threshold is too low and can trigger on normal SharePoint activity
The rule groups only by user.email and ignores source.ip
The rule does not include MITRE ATT&CK mapping
The rule does not include the functional use-case tag uc-o365-001
The severity and risk score are too low for potential external data exposure
The time window is too short to represent abnormal mass sharing behavior
